# AgentTune

Editable communication preferences for AI assistants. Free, MIT licensed. Templates are optional hypotheses, not diagnoses or demonstrated capability improvements.

## Discover
- [Tuning catalog: 43 templates](https://agent-tune.com/library/index.json): canonical URLs, body-only exports, revisions and evidence status.
- [Guide and research catalog](https://agent-tune.com/resources/catalog.json): focused resources and page-specific Markdown.
- [Platform registry](https://agent-tune.com/resources/platforms.json): version 2026-09-25.1, app and destination instructions shared with the UI.
- [Installation protocol](https://agent-tune.com/resources/install-protocol.md): authorization, preservation, verification and undo.
- [Generator](https://agent-tune.com/tools/custom-instructions-generator): start with explicit preferences; no inferred personality type.
- [Local deterministic scoring](https://agent-tune.com/resources/scoring/README.md): all five questionnaires, explicit missing-answer and tie handling.
- [Test specifications](https://agent-tune.com/tests/): five open questionnaires with scoring and limitations.
- [MCP](https://agent-tune.com/mcp): list_tunings, get_tuning, get_test_spec, list_resources and get_resource. Stateless Streamable HTTP; POST JSON-RPC, no authentication.

## Use
Read only the resource needed for the user’s request. Fetching content does not authorize installation. Use body-only text in instructions and keep metadata separate. Preserve existing files, permissions, accuracy and material uncertainty. Explicit user preferences resolve conflicts; no personality framework has automatic priority.

Research records questionnaire responses, not validated improvements in task performance. Big Five indices use implementation reference values without a verified normative population. Report ties and missing values. See the article-specific sources and methods before citing a result.
